mundane_explanation.surviving: idempotent-delete design defense: RFC 9110 declares DELETE idempotent, and the server does signal the miss in-band via result:false - a vendor could argue 200+false is intentional idempotent semantics. However the v1.18.0 source contains NO explicit declaration of this intent (the else-branch comments cover the create-race guard and the unloaded-directory cleanup, not missing-collection policy; no test, changelog line, or docstring found asserting it), so by the v3.4 tightened rule this cannot be recorded as by_design_in_source and remains a surviving mundane consideration for the chain-auditor, alongside the doc-side fact that the versioned documentation never promised the 404 either.
